changes.comment: BREAKING (implementers only): delivery pump and deferred obligations. The host packlet gains TaskDeliveryPump (one owed revision per next(), rendered owed-only so a task owed nothing never blocks another; never self-acknowledging and at-least-once; acknowledge then release; dispose releases first; older revisions disposed only after a terminal discharge; decisions read the pump's own record of what it prepared), DeferredObligations (durable retry obligations as waiting tracked tasks with deterministic (changeRef, role) ids, create-then-wait finished after a crash by resuming the stored registration or adopting a pending task only when its kind and scopes match, stateOf/wait/succeed/cancel/merged (same role only), abandonPending and archiveSettled over the helper's own obligations, due over the due index, waiting, a pure retry schedule and a per-task wait budget; defer answers a settled obligation's terminal status) and ITaskHostWriteGuard, a structural gate around each helper call. IBoundTaskView gains queryDue, an authorized, projected due query over the repository's due index (IBoundTaskQueryFilter names its filter), and IBoundTaskDelivery.prepare gains an options argument whose currentState 'owed-only' renders only owed revisions.
